objective: Backfill historico completo visible en ISCAM 2023-2026 para 130MID, exclusivamente dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto, usando contrato canónico SoftRestaurant por turnos.apertura. Escribir solo dias OK_HEADER_CANONICO y fallar cerrado en diferencias. No modificar encabezado Runtime/KPIs, Sync_Sales, codigo, pagos ni Produccion.

queries.name: mid_detail_parity_2023_2026
queries.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) ventas,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND fecha_operacion>='2023-01-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-12' AND (ISNULL(ventas_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(tickets_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(pax_total,0)<>0) GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), d AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) ventas,COUNT(DISTINCT id_transaccion) tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND fecha_operacion>='2023-01-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-12' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS problem_days,CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fecha IS NULL THEN r.ventas ELSE ABS(r.ventas-ISNULL(d.ventas,0)) END),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS sales_gap_abs FROM r LEFT JOIN d ON d.fecha=r.fecha WHERE d.fecha IS NULL OR ABS(r.ventas-d.ventas)>0.05 OR r.tickets<>d.tickets OR r.pax<>d.pax

queries.name: mid_runtime_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)) min_fecha,MAX(CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)) max_fecha,COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)) dias,CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ventas_total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) ventas FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND fecha_operacion>='2023-01-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-12'
